Three pieces: Lodge L10SK3 12 inch skillet (2021, the workhorse on the truck), Lodge 5 qt Dutch oven (L8DOL3, mum's old one), and a Skeppshult 28 cm I paid £79 for in Feb 2024 because it's smoother. All three are cast iron, all three are heavy, all three get treated the same.

## What seasoning actually is

Thin layers of oil heated past the smoke point until they polymerise into a hard, slightly slick film bonded to the iron. Thick layers go sticky and flake. Thin is the whole game. The carbon steel wok works on the same idea but the surface and the heat are totally different, see [[Carbon steel wok seasoning]].

## Oil

Tried them all:

- flaxseed: hard and pretty, then flaked off in sheets after 2 months. No.
- Crisco: fine, cheap, a bit soft
- Crisbee puck (£14): nice but expensive for the truck
- rapeseed: what I use now. 3p a session.

## Full strip and re-season

Did this on the Skeppshult in March 2024 and the Lodge skillet in Aug 2024 after Tash left it soaking overnight.

1. Oven cleaner (Mr Muscle) in a bin bag for 48 h, scrub off
2. 50/50 white vinegar and water, max 1 hour, it eats bare iron if you leave it
3. rinse, dry on the hob until it goes grey
4. oil all over with kitchen roll, then wipe it off like you made a mistake. It should look dry.
5. upside down, 250°C, 1 hour, cool in the oven
6. repeat 5 times. Took a whole Sunday.

## Daily on the truck

- scrape with the chainmail scrubber while it's still warm
- hot water, a drop of washing-up liquid is fine (modern soap has no lye, the myth is from the 1950s)
- dry on the burner for 2 min
- 2 ml of rapeseed, wipe it in, smoke it 30 s, off
- never in the sink. Never soaking. Tash.

## Rust

Orange spots after the van was off for the 3 weeks in Jan 2025 and the damp got in. Wire scourer, re-oil, one oven cycle, back to normal. If it's a full orange layer, it's a strip job.

## What it's good for

- searing the short ribs, 6 at a time ([[Braised short ribs]])
- fond for [[Pan sauce basics]]
- cornbread, in the 10 inch, 220°C
- not tomato sauces for hours, the acid strips the top layer and it tastes of metal. Max 30 min of acid.

## Heat

Cast iron is slow to heat and holds it. Lodge skillet takes 8 min on the truck burner at medium to get even, there's still a 40°C difference between middle and edge on the IR gun at 4 min. Don't rush it.

## Burns

The handle gets to 200°C plus. Silicone sleeve on the Lodge now (£6). Before that I grabbed it bare in Oct 2023, proper blister across the palm, and got told off by the nurse at Manchester Royal for putting butter on it. Read [[Burns first aid]] and do what it says.
